lines.lyric_translation: In front of the person who loves me,
I can’t even say that I love you
I don’t want to sink to the ground because of that

lines.lyric: Eotteokhae nan ye ye ye ye ye
lines.lyric_hangul: Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah
lines.lyric_translation: What should I do, ye ye ye ye ye
After becoming someone who loves you,
I’m becoming someone who loves myself

lines.lyric_hangul: 울지 않아 너가 아플까 봐 더는
lines.lyric_translation: Since it might hurt you, I don’t cry

lines.lyric_hangul: Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah 아프다 (아프다) 이럴 줄 (이럴 줄)
lines.lyric_translation: Anymore, ye ye ye ye ye / It hurts / I didn’t know

parts.lyric: Deoneun ye ye ye ye ye

lines.lyric_translation: That it would be like this
The ending I wanted so badly is right in front of me

lines.lyric_hangul: 사람 참 간사해 미련 따윈 없던 내가
lines.lyric_translation: People are truly deceitful / I used to not have things like lingering attachments
Yet my heart startles when I’m around you
And makes me want to breathe for no reason
Maybe I was just a young kid who acted tough
But wanted to be hugged

lines.lyric: Nal wihae heullineun nunmul ttohan tteugeopda
lines.lyric_hangul: 날 위해 흘리는 눈물 또한 뜨겁다
lines.lyric_translation: The tears you shed for me are also hot

lines.lyric: Nae soneul japgo itteon neoye sondo tteugeopda
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 손을 잡고 있던 너의 손도 뜨겁다
lines.lyric_translation: Your hands that held mine are hot as well

lines.lyric: Jukdorok geuripda jeongmal jukdorok bogo shipeun neon
lines.lyric_hangul: 죽도록 그립다, 정말 죽도록 보고 싶은 넌
lines.lyric_translation: I miss you to death, I miss you so much I could die
Will I see you if I close my eyes now?

lines.lyric: Nuntteumyeon nae apeseo miso jitteon neoraseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 눈뜨면 내 앞에서 미소 짓던 너라서
lines.lyric_translation: When I open my eyes, I see you smiling before me
I couldn’t even gift you the season of spring
And I hated myself for it

lines.lyric_hangul: 거울 속 내 모습이 흐려지고, 손등에는 따뜻한 게 흘러
lines.lyric_translation: My reflection in the mirror becomes blurry, and / Something warm runs down the back of my hand
In front of the person who loves me,
I can’t even say that I love you
I don’t want to sink to the ground because of that

lines.lyric: Eotteokhae nan ye ye ye ye ye
lines.lyric_hangul: Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah
lines.lyric_translation: What should I do, ye ye ye ye ye
After becoming someone who loves you,
I’m becoming someone who loves myself

lines.lyric_hangul: 울지 않아 너가 아플까 봐 더는
lines.lyric_translation: Since it might hurt you, I don’t cry

lines.lyric: Deoneun ye ye ye ye ye
lines.lyric_hangul: Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah
lines.lyric_translation: Anymore, ye ye ye ye ye
The broken shapes of the pastels
Are like feelings sorted by color
Because of the rising emotions pressing on them,

lines.lyric: Eoneusae geomge seokkyeo muldeureun ttae ganne
lines.lyric_hangul: 어느새 검게 섞여 물들은 때 같네
lines.lyric_translation: They’ve already become like dirt, muddled and dark

lines.lyric: Eojjeomyeon nae ujuneun neoro inhae balgatgo
lines.lyric_hangul: 어쩌면 내 우주는 너로 인해 밝았고
lines.lyric_translation: Maybe my universe was bright because of you,

lines.lyric: Geu sogeseo nan misoreul ireo bon jeok eopseosseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 그 속에서, 난 미소를 잃어 본 적 없었어
lines.lyric_translation: And within it, I never lost my smile

lines.lyric_hangul: 근데 이젠 그림자 밟을 일도 없이 어두운 세상에
lines.lyric_translation: But now, in a world so dark / That I don’t even step on my shadow,

parts.lyric: Geunde ijen geurimja balbeul ildo eopshi

lines.lyric: Neol geurineun ge yuilhan nae haruya
lines.lyric_hangul: 널 그리는 게 유일한 내 하루야
lines.lyric_translation: Drawing you is all I do with my days

lines.lyric: Go back go back nan ne apeseo
lines.lyric_hangul: Go back, go back, 난 네 앞에서
lines.lyric_translation: Go back go back, I’m beginning to wonder
What kind of person I was around you
Like rewinding the film reel of our memories,

lines.lyric_hangul: 다시 꿈을 꾸듯이 말린, 널 잊을 수 있냐고?
lines.lyric_translation: Like rolling it up as if dreaming again, / How could I forget you?

lines.lyric: Go back go back go back go back
lines.lyric_hangul: Go back, go back, go back, go back
lines.lyric_translation: Go back go back go back go back
If only we could go back to that time

lines.lyric: Neol wihae neol wihae neol wihae neol wihae
lines.lyric_hangul: 널 위해, 널 위해, 널 위해, 널 위해
lines.lyric_translation: For you for you for you for you

lines.lyric: Saraganeun ilbunilchoreul akkil su isseul tende
lines.lyric_hangul: 살아가는 일분일초를 아낄 수 있을 텐데
lines.lyric_translation: I would treasure every second of my life
In front of the person who loves me,
I can’t even say that I love you
I don’t want to sink to the ground because of that
